thread:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — launch went well but we have a short list of regressions and a handful of customer UX asks. Thinking a 10-business-day mini-wave: week A = critical fixes, week B = 2 small UX/observability items and ship notes.

Maya Chen: Proposed breakdown:
- Day 1-2: Triage + assign P0/P1 based on customer impact (revenue/compliance first)
- Day 3-7: Fixes + canaries for regressions
- Day 8-10: UX polish + observability hooks + release notes

Samir Patel: Agree on customer-first triage. I picked up two enterprise tickets that blocked pilots. Will prioritize those.

Liam O'Connor: For streaming regressions I want a short-term mitigation rather than full refactor: limit concurrent long-seq aggregation per worker and enable aggressive prefix KV caching for very long contexts. Canary it.

Dena Park: Support flagged three recurring items: embedding dim mismatch on large batches, streaming latency spikes for multi-turn, and unhelpful quota error copy. I'll drop ticket links.

Maya Chen: Owners idea:
- Embedding batch mismatch — @Samir
- Streaming latency mitigation — @Liam
- Quota error copy + SDK retry UX + dashboard tweak — @Dena

Samir Patel: I'll take embeddings. Early theory: pad trimming in export path for quantized models. Quick repro snippet:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model": "redwood-alpha-embed", "input": [..51 items..] }
```
Sometimes returns different vector dims for some inputs. I'll triage and post a PR by Thu EOD.

Liam O'Connor: Canary plan: roll mitigation to 10% workers in staging with traffic replay. If latency improvement <15% we rollback and escalate. I'll run eval on a small customer prompt set.

Dena Park: Drafted quota copy: "Request rate limit reached. Please wait a few seconds and retry, or contact support to request a quota increase." Also will add a short retry UX in SDK (exponential backoff example).

Maya Chen: Good. Add rule: if any fix needs >72 hours to ship we immediately schedule a hotfix meeting and inform affected customers with mitigation.

Samir Patel: If kernel change needed I'll flag immediately. Otherwise aiming for small PRs. Will request sample inputs from customer owners if needed.

Liam O'Connor: I'll post canary results here (latency percentiles, p99/P50) and a rollback checklist. Also will include a quick eval comparing outputs on 10 canonical prompts.

Dena Park: I'll own the dashboard-per-route-cost tweak (small UX) and the SDK retry behavior. PRs aimed for Monday to coordinate release notes.

eng-bot: Deploy canary scheduled for 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z. Will update status messages automatically.

Maya Chen: Success criteria proposal:
- P0 regressions resolved or have acceptable mitigation in prod
- Top 3 customer blocker tickets closed or a documented mitigation/owner
- Two UX improvements shipped with release notes and customer-facing blurb
- Observability hooks (call-path traces) added for at least the streaming endpoint

Samir Patel: Add: run a quick quality check on 10 customer prompts to ensure no generation regressions.

Liam O'Connor: Agree — will run eval after canary and post diffs (BLEU/ROUGE style and latency).

Dena Park: Timeline suggestion: triage today, canaries by Fri, rollout early next week. Daily check-ins 10:30am next 5 biz days.

Maya Chen: OK. Action items:
- Samir: triage + PR for embed mismatch (report Thu EOD)
- Liam: staging canary + eval (Thu-Fri)
- Dena: quota copy + SDK retry UX + dashboard tweak (PR Mon)
- Maya: customer comms + coordinate hotfix meeting if any ticket estimated >3d

Samir Patel: noted. Will ping customer owners.

Liam O'Connor: I'll post canary logs and rollback checklist after the run.

Dena Park: I'll draft the release note blurb and short support snippet.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. Keep updates short here. If any blocker escalate and I'll loop in eng-sre.

Samir Patel: :thumbsup:

Liam O'Connor: :rocket:

Dena Park: :white_check_mark:
